notes: empty function: the whole body is ret (empty virtual methods, no-op callbacks); excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
returns zero: xor eax, eax; ret (false, null, 0); excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
record initializers: clear the 15 words at the second argument, store the first argument after them, return 0; excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
returns a constant: mov eax, imm32; ret, zero-extended to rax; excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
key match: 1 when the size is 16 and the key at rsi equals the 16 bytes at rdi+0x18 (its second half only when its first is not 0), else 0
list length: walks the list whose first node is at rdi+0x30 through each node's next at +0x10, returns the count
list lookup: the dword at +0x18 of node esi of the list at rdi+0x30 (next at +0x10), 0 past its end
64-bit field getter: mov rax, [rdi+K]; ret, one replacement per offset; negative offsets excluded
64-bit field getter with a 32-bit displacement: mov rax, [rdi+K]; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
32-bit field getter: mov eax, [rdi+K]; ret, zero-extended to rax; negative offsets excluded
32-bit field getter with a 32-bit displacement: mov eax, [rdi+K]; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
16-bit field getter: movzx eax, word [rdi+K]; ret; negative offsets excluded
16-bit field getter with a 32-bit displacement: movzx eax, word [rdi+K]; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
8-bit field getter: movzx eax, byte [rdi+K]; ret (mov al, [rdi+K] keeps rax's upper bytes and is excluded)
8-bit field getter with a 32-bit displacement: movzx eax, byte [rdi+K]; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
member or base address: lea rax, [rdi+K]; ret, reads no memory
member or base address with a 32-bit displacement: lea rax, [rdi+K]; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
first-field getter: mov rax, [rdi]; ret
first 32-bit field getter: mov eax, [rdi]; ret, zero-extended to rax
64-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], rsi; ret; leaves rax
64-bit field setter with a 32-bit displacement: mov [rdi+K], rsi; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
32-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], esi; ret; leaves rax
32-bit field setter with a 32-bit displacement: mov [rdi+K], esi; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
16-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], si; ret; leaves rax
16-bit field setter with a 32-bit displacement: mov [rdi+K], si; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
8-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], sil; ret; leaves rax
8-bit field setter with a 32-bit displacement: mov [rdi+K], sil; ret, offset 0x80 or more; negative offsets excluded
first-field setter: mov [rdi], rsi; ret; leaves rax
first 32-bit field setter: mov [rdi], esi; ret; leaves rax
identity: mov rax, rdi; ret
returns the second argument: mov rax, rsi; ret
atomic counter increment: mov eax, 1; lock xadd [rdi+8], eax; ret, returns the old count zero-extended
tagged pointer getter: mov rax, [rdi+K]; and rax, -2; ret, the 64-bit field with bit 0 cleared
record clear: mov qword [rdi+8], 0; mov qword [rdi], 0; ret; leaves rax
record clear: four mov qword [rdi+K], 0 from 0x18 down to 0; ret; leaves rax
record clear: mov dword [rdi+0x10], 0; two mov qword [rdi+K], 0; ret; leaves rax
returns 0.0f: vxorps xmm0, xmm0, xmm0; ret (all of xmm0 zero)
